common: Use case: stylized-concept. Production world-pickup sprite for UNDERCROFT, a forgotten 1993 first-person dungeon crawler. The input image is the accepted 16px INVENTORY ICON reference board: match the requested item's colour, material and identifying shape so floor object and pack icon are clearly the same possession. Paint ONE isolated object on genuine TRANSPARENT background, NO cast shadow, NO ground/floor patch, no scene, no grid/checkerboard. Three-quarter view looking down at an item resting on flagstones; broad painterly gouache/oil clusters, aged practical materials, chunky clear silhouette. The camera is above the floor, not an overhead map. Pale ivory/ash rim from upper-left lamp light, dark slate occlusion edge but not a thick cartoon outline. Restrained Undercroft slate grey, teal, rusty brown, brass/ochre and ivory. Will be reduced to a 64x48 near sprite and 24px-wide far canvas. Big readable shapes, not intricate linework. No person/hand, no extra objects, no letters or UI.

items.bone: HAM BONE: one weathered ivory ham bone lying flat diagonally, two visibly knobbly ends and narrow pale shaft, slight warm grime in cracks, no meat. Match bone icon with clear double-knobbed ends. Not a smooth stick or a skull.
items.bread: DRY BREAD: a small squat oval half-loaf of dry rustic bread resting flat, warm ochre/golden crust, deep reddish brown underside, two or three broad scored pale cracks across its domed top, crumb glimpse at one broken end. Match bread icon. Dry and old but edible, no mould, no plate, no cloth.
items.tonic: RED TONIC: a squat broad-shouldered glass flask standing on a stable flat base, visibly filled with muted brick-red tonic. Short neck and square brown cork, simple cream parchment label with a single dark square blot (NO letters). Match tonic icon's square body and red/brown contents. Pale reflected glass rim on left, two broad red planes, worn primitive bottle, no ornate potion stand.
items.coat: TWO-STATE source sheet, two equal square cells side by side, transparent gutter, same angle and scale. PADDED COAT lying as a crumpled/spread garment on the floor, torso and short sleeves recognizable, NOT standing up as if worn, no body/mannequin. Match coat icon: muted teal quilted cloth, brass/ochre front edging, 2-3 simple buttons. LEFT INTACT: thick puffed quilted panels, soft bulky folds, sleeves spread low, worn but usable. RIGHT PADDING SPENT: the exact SAME teal coat, visibly FLATTENED, torn open at shoulder and hem, 2-3 large tears with dirty ivory stuffing tufts, collapsed thin sleeves and crushed quilting, ragged silhouette. Do not change its colour or invent a different coat. Whole garments isolated, no loose detached specks or cloth scraps outside outline.
